speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness after childbirth. To help me narrow down the cause, how many days postpartum are you, and has your lochia changed in color or amount?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Urinary Retention with possible underlying Prolapse or retained placental fragments, given the history of prolonged labor, decreased bowel sounds, and specific symptoms of urinary frequency with uterine tenderness.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Post-void residual volume measurement.
